text: I sure am!

label: sdc01_0110_brother_06
text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)], this is my grandma.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0110_gmother_02
text: Well, fancy that! A friend of Kieran’s! We’re\ndelighted to have you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0037)]

label: sdc01_0110_gfather_04
text: Oh, my, is it really already sundown?[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0110_gmother_03
text: Goodness me, I’d nearly forgotten. The Festival\nof Masks starts tonight, doesn’t it?[VAR 0x0114(0037)]

label: sdc01_0110_gmother_04
text: Come now, Kieran. You too, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0037)]

label: sdc01_0110_gmother_05
text: I’ll get out some jinbei for you both so you can\ngo to the festival all gussied up.[VAR 0x0114(0037)]

text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I imagine a stylish young thing like yourself could\nmake good use of this too,\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0037)]

label: sdc01_0110_sister_03
text: Oh, really? Is that so...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0110_brother_10
text: What’s it matter anyway! What’re YOU doin’\nback here?![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0110_sister_04
text: Oh, right. Gran, I couldn’t find my mask for the\nfestival.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0110_gmother_11
text: Oh, the masks? They should be in the shed.\nI put them there after last year’s festival.[VAR 0x0114(0037)]

label: sdc01_0110_gfather_06
text: It shouldn’t be locked, so you three can go have\na rummage and see what you find.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]
